subject: Newsletter signals for company profiles
body:
Dealroom already attaches entity-level news and sentiment to companies, and people records enriched from 40+ sources. Public newsletters are a source class we hold in a structured form, and I do not know whether they are already inside your 40+.

NewsletterFIT indexes more than 27,000 publications and 143,000 articles, with companies, people, topics, guests and 2,200 sponsors extracted, each with the article URL and date. It could add a newsletter mention field or an attention signal on company profiles.

Two questions: is newsletter coverage new to you, and would a sample of 500 companies with dated mentions be worth a look?
